name: R020-hyper-beam-recharge-asleep
why: Challenge 7. The player's Aerodactyl 531 (Choice Band, base speed 130) uses Hyper Beam every turn it can; Gen 3 always sets the recharge (battle_script_commands.c:2728-2732). The opponent leads with Exeggutor 534 (Frustration, Curse, Sleep Powder, Rest; Chesto Berry), which survives a banded Hyper Beam and moves after it. When the AI picks Sleep Powder on a Hyper Beam turn, Aerodactyl falls asleep with the recharge pending; on the next turn CANCELER_ASLEEP stops it before CANCELER_RECHARGE, and the end-turn clean-up removes STATUS2_RECHARGE when the timer reaches 0 (battle_main.c:4878-4883). Exeggutor's Rest plus Chesto Berry gives it more full-HP turns to try; Meganium 541 (Grass Whistle) and Slowking 506 (Yawn: a Yawn on the recharge turn puts the user to sleep right after its next Hyper Beam; Ice Beam freezes are another way) are the replacements. Ursaring 805 and Snorlax 826 also have Hyper Beam in slot 0.
